patch_list: Removes all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded).
Coins inflated to 1,000,000,000 on save load; purchases, upgrades, rentals and repairs never cost coins.
Gold is inflated to 1,000,000,000 on save load; gold packs in the store also grant gold.
